positions.title: Appraisal Engagement Specialist
positions.description:
Ensured compliance with federal law and bank policy by obtaining appropriate real estate collateral valuations
Managed the valuation ordering process by maintaining constant communication with our vendors to guarantee an accurate and timely product is delivered to our clients
Provided general customer support via phone and email by  answering questions from the lending field regarding said collateral valuation laws and policies 
Arranged timely payment of vendor payments as well as verifying proper invoicing of bank fees related to the valuation process  
Trained other staff members and assist in the testing and roll out of three different work flow management systems
Provided general computer technical assistance to other department members
